# High Latency in Parts of Sfax

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** capacity at `AGG-SFX-02`
- **Confidence:** high (Direct KPI deviations and high PRB alarms observed on the affected sites starting at the exact time of the traffic spike, while sibling sites showed no issues and external changes, maintenance, and failures were ruled out.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-18 18:30 to 2026-09-18 22:12
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-18 18:30
- **Affected:** S-SFX-002, S-SFX-010

## Summary

Local traffic congestion and capacity surge on sites S-SFX-002 and S-SFX-010 sharing aggregation router AGG-SFX-02.

High latency, increased active users, download volumes, and drop rates affecting sites S-SFX-002 and S-SFX-010 between 2026-09-18 18:30 and 2026-09-18 22:12.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-18 18:30: Anomaly detector alert active for region SFX involving 2 sites (S-SFX-002, S-SFX-010) with active_users and latency deviations. [T1, ALR-0028]
- 2026-09-18 18:30: Earliest onset of latency deviation above baseline on site S-SFX-002. [T6]
- 2026-09-18 18:36: Warning HIGH_PRB alarm raised on site S-SFX-010. [T4, ALM-000391]
- 2026-09-18 18:37: Warning HIGH_PRB alarm raised on site S-SFX-002. [T4, ALM-000392]
- 2026-09-18 22:06: HIGH_PRB alarm cleared on site S-SFX-002. [ALM-000392]
- 2026-09-18 22:12: HIGH_PRB alarm cleared on site S-SFX-010. [ALM-000391]

## Evidence

- Sites S-SFX-002 and S-SFX-010 experienced latency and active users deviations starting at 2026-09-18 18:30. [T1, T6, ALR-0028]
- Sites S-SFX-002 and S-SFX-010 share aggregation router AGG-SFX-02 and core UPF CORE-UPF-02. [T7, T8, T9]
- No external events, configuration changes, or maintenance windows were scheduled or occurred on the affected nodes and their parents during the incident window. [T2, T3, T5]
- Sibling sites S-SFX-003 and S-SFX-006 showed no KPI deviations during the window. [T10]
- Site S-SFX-002 experienced sharp spikes in active users, download volume, and drop rate. [ANM-000204, ANM-000205, ANM-000206]

## Hypotheses

1. **capacity** at AGG-SFX-02: confirmed. Traffic surge and high PRB utilization observed on sites connected to AGG-SFX-02 with no external factors, maintenance, or changes present. [T1, T4, T6, RB-CONGESTION#03]
2. **bad_change** at AGG-SFX-02: rejected. No configuration changes were found on the nodes or their parents during the incident timeframe. [T5]
3. **transport_failure** at AGG-SFX-02: rejected. No transport failures or link alarms were logged, and traffic successfully passed with high volume. [T4]

## Ruled out

- T3: No maintenance windows were scheduled on the affected sites, aggregation router, or core node.
- T5: No configuration changes were executed during the relevant timeframe.
- T2: No external events were recorded for the region.

## Recommended actions

- Monitor traffic growth on sites connected to AGG-SFX-02 and plan for capacity expansion if localized traffic surges recur.

report.root_cause_summary: Local traffic congestion and capacity surge on sites S-SFX-002 and S-SFX-010 sharing aggregation router AGG-SFX-02.

report.title: High Latency in Parts of Sfax

confounders.why: Harmless scheduler parameter tuning on S-SFX-002 88 min before the congestion; the cause is a demand surge, not this change.

truth.notes: Demand surge saturated the radio resources of S-SFX-002, S-SFX-010; there was no external event to explain it.
